description: This file contains shell functions and scripts used for platform-specific upgrade operations on embedded devices running OpenWrt. It includes functions for image verification, copying configuration files, updating EFI system partitions, and performing partition arrangements during system upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the partition layout of an image to ensure it matches the existing device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a designated partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates the EFI system partition with files from a specified image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function orchestrating partition updates, image deployment, and configuration adjustments.
